summary: Verified L5/L10 stats consistency bug fix. All 7 backend tests pass. Game logs are now sorted by date before calculating L5/L10/L25 stats across War Zone, Safe Haven, Front Lines, and Player Profile endpoints. Ajay Mitchell L5=16.8, L10=14.8 for PTS is consistent across all endpoints.

war_zone_l5_l10_stats.description: GET /api/v3/war-zone returns picks with l5_avg, l10_avg, h5_rate, h10_rate

player_profile_l5_l10_stats.description: GET /api/command/profile/{player} returns lines with l5_avg, l10_avg

consistency_war_zone_vs_profile.description: L5/L10 stats are consistent between War Zone and Player Profile endpoints (tested 3 players, <1 point difference)

consistency_player_with_badges.description: GET /api/v3/player-with-badges/{player} returns props with consistent l5_avg, l10_avg

date_sorting_fix.description: All calculation functions (_calculate_l5_avg, _calculate_l10_avg, _calculate_h5_hit_rate, _calculate_h10_hit_rate, _calculate_l25_hit_rate) now sort game logs by date (most recent first) before slicing

player_detail_l5_l10_display.description: Player detail page shows L5, L10, SZN columns with correct values (Ajay Mitchell: L5=16.8, L10=14.8, SZN=14.3)

search_and_navigate.description: Search for player and navigate to detail page works correctly

bug_verification.original_issue: War Zone and Player Detail card showed different L10 stats for player Ajay Mitchell
bug_verification.root_cause: Game logs were being sliced [:N] without sorting by date first, causing inconsistent stats between endpoints
bug_verification.fix_applied: All 5 calculation functions now sort game logs by date (most recent first) before slicing

critical_code_review_comments: Date sorting fix correctly implemented in picks_getter_service.py functions
get_game_date() helper handles multiple date formats: game.date, game_date, date
All functions use sorted(game_logs, key=get_game_date, reverse=True) before [:N] slicing
Backend restarted successfully after changes (hot reload detected)
